project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides audit completed 2026-08-09. The unchanged ONS 2024 built-up area is the active inclusion boundary. Historic England designations and public current OpenStreetMap visitor facilities were filtered point-in-polygon. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-09: 9 of 102 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown. Bedfordshire and Northamptonshire standalone attraction audit added 2026-08-09. These are explicit Home-only regional destinations and do not alter the host town planner or tourist rating.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
